sentences.text: Watch a matrix act: the unit square {applies}stretches into a parallelogram.
sentences.spoken: Watch a matrix act: the unit square stretches into a parallelogram.

sentences.text: Its determinant is five, {lands}so the area scales by five.
sentences.spoken: Its determinant is five, so the area scales by five.

sentences.text: Squaring a sum begins as a product: {writes}a plus b, times itself.
sentences.spoken: Squaring a sum begins as a product: a plus b, times itself.

sentences.text: Multiply out, and {collects}the mixed terms collect into two a b.
sentences.spoken: Multiply out, and the mixed terms collect into two a b.

sentences.text: The odd numbers stack as L shapes: one, three, five, {gnomons}seven.
sentences.spoken: The odd numbers stack as L shapes: one, three, five, seven.

sentences.text: Each L completes a square: {lands}sixteen cells in all.
sentences.spoken: Each L completes a square: sixteen cells in all.
